description: This file defines the class SugarFieldDatetimecombo, a custom field type for handling date and time combo inputs in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It includes methods to generate Smarty templates for edit, search, and import views, as well as methods to save and sanitize date/time data.

classes.name: SugarFieldDatetimecombo
classes.description: A custom CRM field class for handling date and time combo input fields in the SugarCRM / SuiteCRM platform.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates the Smarty template variables for the 'Edit' view of the date-time combo field.

methods.name: getImportViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares Smarty variables for import view, reusing the edit view setup.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares Smarty variables for search view, including range searches and individual search.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateValue
methods.description: Returns the date-time value formatted for email templates.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Converts input date/time string into database format and assigns it to the bean before saving.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes and converts imported date/time values into the database format, ensuring proper parsing and validation.
